Resume operations - RU E-Line/tested lubr to 2500 psi/OK. Opened well. RIH/set RBP @ 208'MD/tested same to 2500 psi/OK. POOH/RD E-Line. Installed DHT top flange/tested to 500 psi/OK. WELL IS T/A - WORK COMPLETED - FINAL REPORT.
FIRST REPORT - P/A - RD surface lines/equip. Performed mast inpsection/OK. Prep to skid HPU over well.
Performed general mainteance/housekeeping - Waiting on SL equip.
Performed general mainteance/housekeeping - Waiting on SL equip.
WOW. Equip arrived/offloaded same. Commence RU SLU.
Completed RU SLU/equip/tested lubr to 250/2500 psi/OK.

Function accu/OK. Bubbled tested/no bubbles/OK. Shut in dry tree. WOW. RIH w/PA to equalize plug to 97'SLM - could not get deeper. POOH/LD PA. Tested lubr to 2500 psi/OK. Opened well. RIH w/IB to 103'SLM. POOH/LD IB.

Tested lubr to 2500 psi/OK. RIH w/PT to 170'SLM. latched/equalized jarred on plug. Sheared PT. POOH. Tested lubr to 2500 psi/OK. RIH w/shear down, to 172'SLM/latched/jarred on plug/no movement. POOH/LD shear down - will cut wire.

Tested lubr to 2500 psi/OK. RIH w/PT to 171'SLM/latched plug. Jarred on same/no movement. POOH/LD PT. Performed compressibility test to 2000 psi/OK. Tested lubr to 2500 psi/OK. RIH w/PT to 171'SLM. Latched plug/jarred free. POOH/LD PT/plug. Bubbled test/shut in well due to H2S reading/18 PPM. Commence build test up on well.
Build up test on well 24.50 psi. Waiting on personnel to arrive to verify HS2 readings.

Build up test on well 24.50 psi. Vessel arrived w/HS2 equip/personnel for readings. Monitored for build up -well press 26.25 psi. Total safety peformed H2S test on A004/A015 - there was no H2S detected w/total safety equip (possible faulty testing equip when test conducted on 4/11). Will RD equip and move to A015.RD equip. Tested tree cap to 500 psi/OK.

FIRST REPORT - P/A - Removed hatch cover F/well. Skidded HPU floor section & riser package over well/secured same (APM step 4). Skidded HPU 8' to clear well in prep to RU 13 5/8" BOP'S. Installed HPU stair tower (APM step 3).
Offloaded 13 5/8" BOP'S. WOW. Prep to NU BOP'S.
WOW. NU BOP'S/equip. Commence testing 250/3000 psi.

Completed testing BOP'S (APM step 5). Function tested BOP'S. Performed accu drawdown/OK. RU BN/FL. RIH w/BHA/OS to 617'MD. Dispalced well w/9.3# NaCl. RIH to 652'MD. Performed compressability test to 2000 psi/OK/no obstruction to 5300'MD. Performed blind pack off on tbg/gained 3K.

Circ well. POOH/LD BHA/OS/2 jts of tbg. RIH w/BHA/OS to 684'MD/fish. Worked pipe. POOH/LD BHA/OS/fish 246' of tbg/TOF @ 930'MD. Circ well. RIH w/OS & grapple to 930'MD/engaged fish. POOH/LD OS/grapple/fish 93' of tbg/TOF @ 1025'MD. RIH w/OS/grapple to 1025'MD. Worked pipe/circ/w.9.3# NaCL.
POOH/LD OS/grapple/fish/ 1084' of tbg/TOF @ 2114'MD. WOW. RIH w/OS & grapple to 1025'MD/engaged fish. Worked pipe/circ.

Completed POOH/LD OS/grapple/fish 3771' of tbg. Checked for norm on tbg/OK (APM step 6). Cleaned/cleared RF. WOW. TIH w/csg scraper assy to 4195'MD. Washed & reamed to 4258'MD. POOH/LD assy (APM step 7). Circ hole clean to 9.3# NaCl.
TIH/set BP @ 4200'MD (APM step 9). Took on 9.3# NaCL. POOH/LD ST. RIH w/CBL to 4200'MD/ Logged to surface. RD LT (APM step 10).

RIH w/MS/pumped a 45 CF Class H cmt F/3957-4200'MD (APM step 11). PU to 3500'MD. WOC (APM step 12). Reversed circ. Pumped/circ out nerf ball. Cleaned cmt equip. Tested cmt plug to 1000 psi/OK (APM step 14). TIH/tagged TOC @ 3957'MD (APM step 13). Spotted 78 bbl 9.3# inhib NACL w/spec-cide/H2S scavanger F/3957-1500'MD. POOH/LD MS. Cleaned/cleared RF.

RIH w/perf assy to 1530'MD. Perf 7" csg F/1520-30'MD (APM step 15). Circ 92 bbl of 9.3# NACL. POOH/LD perf gun - guns did not fire. RD BN/FL to change ring gasket for BOP testing. Disconnected equip. Lifted BOP stack/replaced ring gasket. Lowered BOP stack down on DHT/MU equip. Commence testing BOP'S.
Completed testing BOP'S. Function tested BOP'S. Performed function test on accu/OK. RU BN/FL.

RIH w/perf assy to 1530'MD. Perf 7" csg F/1520-30'MD - 2nd attempt(APM step 15). Circ 40 bbl of 9.3# NACL. POOH/LD perf assy. TIH w/perf assy to 675'MD. Perf 7" F/665-675'MD (base on log run in step 10). Set champ pkr @ 675'MD (APM step 17). Circ between 7" X 10 3/4" (APM step 17).
Circ between 7" X 10 3/4". POOH/LD perf assy. POOH/LD champ pkr. RIH/set CR @ 1500MD (APM step 18). Est circ down 7" into 10 3/4" perfs back up top perfs above CR (APM step 19).

Pumped a 145 CF Class H cmt plug in 7" X 10 3/4" annulus F/1200-1500'MD & 252' cmt plug on top of CR F/1500-1248'MD (APM step 20). PU/reversed circ. Pumped nerf ball down DP. WOC (APM step 21). TIH/tagged TOC @ 1248'MD/set down 15K (APM step 22) Tested cmt plug to 1000 psi/OK (APM step 23). Spotted 6 bbl of SP-CIDE scavenger F/1268-1100'MD.

POOH/LD MS. RIH/cut 7"csg @ 396'/85'MD. Circ 9.2# NACL thru 7" X 10 3/4" annulus (APM step 24). POOH/LD cutter assy. RD BN/FL/EXT. RD BOP'S/dry hole tree (APM step 25). Skidded HPU EAST of well. RIH/speared 7" csg @ WH/csg free. Pulled csg slips (APM step 26). POOH/LD 48' of 7" csg F/85'MD. LD spear assy. Skidded HPU back over well.
NU BOP'S/riser as FLOWPATH stack for pilot milling operations on 7" csg. Tested break to 250/1000 psi/OK (APM step 27). NU BN/FL. TIH w/spear assy & grapple to 85'MD/engaged 7" csg/free.

POOH/LD 357' of 7" csg/spear assy/grapple. TIH w/mill assy to 395'MD. Displaced well w/clean 9.3# NaCl. Milled to 411'MD. Circ well clean. POOH/LD mill assy. TIH w/mill assy to 411'MD. Milled to 418'MD.
Milled to 449'MD. Pumped sweep/circ hole clean. POOH/LD mill assy. TIH w/mill assy to 449'MD. Milled to 459'MD. Pumped sweep/circ hole clean. TOOH/LD mill assy.
TIH w/mill assy to 459'MD. Milled to 491'MD. Pumped sweep/circ hole clean. TOOH/LD mill assy. TIH w/mill assy to 471'MD. Washed/reamed to 491'MD. Circ well. Milled to 508'MD.
Milled to 517'MD. WOW. Milled to 554'MD. Pumped sweep/circ hole clean. POOH/LD mill assy. TIH w/CO assy to 515'MD. Washed/reamed to 554''MD. POOH/LD CO assy. TIH w/mill assy to 554'MD.
Milled to 637'MD. Pumped sweep/circ hole clean.
Offload CT and equipment. R/U CT equipment, pumps and surface lines.  Attempted to check pressure on tree, valves leaking (crown and wing).  S/D for night.
Checked valves.  Opened SCSSV. Tbg psi 640 psi. Closed valves. Bled to zero.  Valves leaking. Began repair of crown and wing valves. S/D for night.
Finished installing wing and crown valves and 4-way block on tree. S/D for night.

R/U to test crown and wing valves, W/L nipple valve would not hold pressure.  Onsite BSEE inspector, Mr. Viola gave verbal approval to R/U riser and BOPs on tree. Installed riser and CT BOPs on tree. Tested valves 250/5000, high test failed. Tested to 5000 psi, failed.  Filled BOPs w/SW, opened line to pump, fluid dropped.  Pulled and replaced discharge valves in pump. Tested tree valves 250/5000 psi and valves 250/5000 psi, ok. S/D for night.

Installed injector head.  Pull tested connector 10k.  Tested treating line, connector and CT to 250/7000 psi, ok.  Tested BOPs 250/4000 psi, ok.  Hookup SCSSV, checked casing pressure = 1050 psi. Tubing pressure 550 psi.  TIH, tagged SCSSV. Pumped gel pills to 5137.  Spotted 1 bbl Xylene.  POOH. S/D for night.
Open Well. Had 280 psi on same, attempted to bled off pressure, well flowed. TIH with jet wash tool to 8736', squeezed 10 bbls Xylene. POOH. S/D for night.
Checked all equipment. Opened well, TP 300 psi. Flowed well. S/D for night.
Turned well over to production. R/D Equipment, skid to C10.  Last Report.

RU CT and injector head.  Locked open SCSSV, tested connector, treating line and coil to 250/4500 psi.  Pull tested connector 10k, ok.  Tested BSRs against gate valve 250/4500 psi.  Failed to get through tree due to partially closed SSV.  Secured well.
Repaired SSV and made gauge run.  R/U CT and tested BOP's to 5000 psi, master valve leaking, bled off pressure.  R/U WL and made gauge run to 550' on LS and SS.  Secured well.

Opened well on SS.  R/U W/L lubricator, tested same to 3000 psi.  TIH and set "DX" plug in X-nipple at 382' wlm. Closed SCSSV, set BPV in hanger. R/D from SS.  Opened well on LS, R/U lubricator, tested same to 3000 psi.  TIH and set "DX" plug in nipple at 416' WLM.  Closed SCSSV, set BPV in hanger. R/D W/L.  Checked psi on both strings. Checked voids. Break and removed flowline and bottom flange on tree.  Secured well.

Removed tree.  Removed old master valve and installed new master valve, N/U tree. Tested voids 240/5000 psi. R/U W/L lubricator on SS, tested to 500 psi, pulled BPV, set test plug in hanger.  R/D W/L.  R/U W/L on LS, tested LS 500 psi, ok. Secured Well.

R/L lubricator on SS, tested to 3000 psi.  Plled tree test plug in hanger.  Opened SCSSV, pulled DX plug. Closed SCSSV R/D lub.  R/U lubricator on LS, tested to 3000 psi.  Pulled test plug from hanger. Opened SCSSV, tested lub 3000 psi. Pulled plug at 448'.  Closed SCSSV, R/D W/L. R/U CT, pull tested connector to 10k. Opened SCSSV. Tested riser flange to 250/4500 psi. Washed LS to 7663', failed to pass bridge.  Circulated hole clean, no sand to surface, no casing communication.  POOH.  Secured w

RU WL, tested lubricator 3000 psi. RIH w/ IB to 7993' wlm - impression of tubing stop.  RIH w/ pulling tool and recovered collar stop.  RIH w/ IB to 7843 ' wlm - no impression.  RD WL.  RU CT, pull tested connector to 10k. Tested break 240/4500 psi, washed sand from 7843'-8993', pumped four 5 bbl Hi Vis pills and circulated tubing clean.  POOH.  Secured well.
Attempted to run memory log, failed.  Improper equipment.  Secured well.
Ran memory log to 7000', RU CT, secured well.

Tested CT BOP's 250/4500 psi. Tested coil, injector line, rams and rear choke 250/7500 psi. RIH w/ mill, milled @ 8150'-60', made Hi-Vis sweeps.  RD CT, RU WL, tested lubricator 500 psi.  RIH w/ spang jars and GR/CCL to 8632', failed to pass bridge w/ up to 400k overpull.  Secured well.

RU cased-hole WL and tested lub. to 3000 psi.  Ran w/ CCL/GR, dummy gun to 8478' - failed to pass bridge.  POOH logging from 8478'-8000'.  RU to run IB, tested lub. to 3000 psi, set down at 8648', PU 100', tool fell to 8993' elm.  Correlate to tubing detail.  Made second run - failed to pass bridge - POOH logging from 8475'-8250'.  Made third run-sat down at 8648', POOH 200', TIH and sat down at 8490'. POH, R/D W/L. Secured well.

RU CT, tested BOP's 250/4500 psi.  Washed to 9003' ctm and made 4 Hi-Vis sweeps.  Worked CT through 9003'-8000' - no drag.  RD CT BOP's, installed BSRs on lower stack, NU BOP's tested break 250/4500 psi.  Secured well.
Tested BOPs, BSRs, kill line, check valve 250/5000 psi.  Tested coil, rams, rear choke 250/7000 psi.  RIH w/ perforating guns, failed to fire. POOH.  Secured well.
Circulated hole clean, RIH w/ perforating gun and reperforated the TP-11B FB-B @ 8990'-8996' w/ 6 spf as originally proposed.  Secured well.

Removed BN. Skidded HPU off well 18' North. ND BOP's/riser spools. RU/RD frac valve (RPM step 14). Removed tbg head flange. Skidded PU aft over well. RIH w/spear assy/engaged 7" csg. WOW. Offloaded E-line equip/RU same. RIH/logged w/CBL in 9 5/8" csg to 326'MD. POOH/LD CBL. RD E-Line (RPM step 18). TIH w/csg cutter to 321'MD/cut 9 5/8" csg. Circ 20 bbl 8.6# treated SW up 9 5/8" X 13 3/8" csg annulus. Displaced 8.6# treated SW in returns.

POOH/LD cutter (RPM step 19 - step 20 N/A). RIH w/spear assy/speared 9 5/8" csg at WH. Pulled/LD 9 5/8" csg. LD spear. Completed POOH/LD 9 5/8" csg (RPM step 23). Checked for norm/OK. Removed FL/BN. WOW. POOH/LD assy/check knives. TIH w/cutter assy to 271'MD. Cut 8" of window in 20" csg. WOW. Performed general mainteance. POOH/LD assy. Changed knives. TIH w/cutter assy to 266'MD. Unable to get deeper. Pumped well w/full returns.

RD FL/BN. Skidded/secured HPU F/well. ND 21 1/4" Flowpath/riser. Skidded HPU South. RIH w/grapple/spear assy/latched 13 3/8"/20"/36" csgs. Csgs moving w/270K pull. Trim WH to fit thru HPU floor. Commence pulling/cutting/LD 13 3/8"/20"36" csgs/check for norm/OK. Backloaded WH onto boat.
Continued pulling/cutting/LD 13 3/8"/20"36" csgs/check for norm/OK. Wrap w/visqueen. WOW.

Completed pulling/cutting/LD 13 3/8"/20"36" csgs/check for norm/OK. Wrap w/visqueen - 214' (RPM step 30). Backloaded csgs onto boat. Installed covers over deck holes (RPM step 31). All csgs - 13 3/8" - 20" - 36" - cut 28'BML - Well is P/A - Skidded HPU to B001 - FINAL REPORT.

Commence testing BOP'S.

Pumped pig thru coil/3/4" ball. WOC. Washed thru cmt equip/performed housekeeping & preventive maintenance. Tested cmt plug on 7" & 2 7/8" X 2 3/8" tbg to 1000 psi/OK.

WOW. Stab inj head on RCT cutter. Tested break. Opened well. RIH w/RCT cutter to 9326'CTM. Installed 7/16" ball/pumped 20 bbl SW. Did not see ball seat. Opened 7" csg valve, pressured up on CT by tbg annulas to 215 psi - no flow. Closed 7" csg valve. POOH to w/CT to surface - continuious fill tbg annulas.

Secured well, removed inj head/break down BHA - no sign of ball. Installed was nozzle/inj head. Installed/pump 5/8" ball 20 bbl SW. Broke inj head & retrieved 7/16" & 5/8" balls. Performed housekeeping/maintenace while waiting on boat - cutter. Boat arrived - offloaded equip. MU TS on CT/stab on BOP'S. Pressured quick test sub to 5000 psi. Bled to zero. Opened well. POOH w/cutter - secured well. Break inj head.
